banks.question: Which statements are supported?
banks.answer: The converter is being validated against multiple electronic bank statement layouts. Specific banks and layout variants will be listed as they are verified.

accuracy.question: Why should I review the conversion result?
accuracy.answer: The converter keeps table headers and cell text where it can. Complex layouts, blurred text, or uneven columns can leave rows marked "DISCREPANCY" or "UNVERIFIABLE". Check the Excel file against the original PDF before you use it.

quota.question: How many pages can I convert each day?
quota.answer: Anonymous users can convert {anonymousPages} page per day, and signed-in users can convert {authenticatedPages} pages per day. Monthly plans include {standardPages} pages for Standard, {professionalPages} pages for Professional, and {enterprisePages} pages for Enterprise.

scans.question: Can I convert scanned or encrypted PDFs?
scans.answer: The first release focuses on electronic PDFs with selectable text that open normally. Scanned files, password-protected files, or PDFs without recognizable tables may not convert.

storage.question: Are my PDF, Excel file, or transactions saved?
storage.answer: No. They are used for the current conversion and download only and are not added to file history. Once you leave the current flow, the result cannot be downloaded again.

failure.question: What happens if conversion fails?
failure.answer: The page reports the failure and does not provide an invalid Excel file. Failed conversions do not use quota; partial results count PDF pages.

Terms.title: Terms of service
Terms.intro: This service is operated by ReAvid Ltd and provided through <site>{domain}</site>. Read these terms and the privacy policy before using the conversion and subscription services.
Terms.availability: PDF to Excel conversion and PayPal subscriptions are provided according to the current page state. Plan prices and availability may change with service configuration.

service.title: Service scope
service.body: The service organizes transaction information from supported bank statement PDFs into Excel files for download and review. Supported banks, file types, and processing limits are described on the service page. We do not provide bank account connections, banking services, or financial, tax, or legal advice.

authorization.title: Authorization to upload files
authorization.body: Upload only statements that you are authorized to use and process. Make sure your upload and processing of personal or financial information comply with applicable law and your obligations to other people. Do not upload files obtained without authorization.

accuracy.title: Reviewing conversion results
accuracy.body: Statement layout, clarity, and content can affect extraction. Results may contain missing, duplicated, or incorrectly identified fields. Compare the Excel file with the original statement before bookkeeping, filing, submitting materials, or making another decision.

quota.title: Free quota
quota.body: Anonymous users can convert {anonymousPages} PDF page per day, and signed-in free users can convert {authenticatedPages} PDF pages per day. Standard includes {standardPages} pages per month, Professional includes {professionalPages}, and Enterprise includes {enterprisePages}. Daily quota resets in UTC and plan quota follows the current PayPal billing period. Failed conversions do not use quota; partial results count PDF pages.

subscription.title: Subscriptions and payment
subscription.body: Standard, Professional, and Enterprise plans renew monthly. Prices are shown before purchase. Payment is completed through PayPal and is charged only after you confirm the purchase. PayPal may send subscription status, renewal, and payment failure information to this service. Manage automatic renewal for a subscription in your PayPal account.

files.title: Files and downloads
files.body: Uploaded PDFs, extracted transactions, and generated Excel files are used to complete the current conversion and download only. They are not kept as persistent file history. Keep your original statement and downloaded result yourself; the service does not provide historical re-downloads after the current flow ends.

prohibited.title: Prohibited misuse
prohibited.body: Do not use the service to forge or misrepresent financial records, infringe another person's rights, commit fraud, distribute malicious files, or bypass quotas, security measures, or access limits. We may restrict service access for illegal or clearly abusive activity.

rights.title: Ownership
rights.body: You retain the rights you have to files and their contents. Uploading a file gives us only the permission needed to process it for the current conversion; it does not transfer ownership. Rights in the website software, interface, and brand remain with their lawful owners.

liability.title: Availability and liability
liability.body: We work to keep the service available but do not guarantee that every file will convert, that the service will always be available, or that results will be completely accurate. To the extent allowed by law, we are not liable for indirect losses caused by failure to review results, unsupported formats, or service interruptions. This does not exclude liability or user rights that cannot be excluded by law.

privacy.title: Privacy and personal information
privacy.body: How files and personal information are handled is described in the <link>privacy policy</link>.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
changes.body: We may update these terms when the service or legal requirements change and will show the update date on this page. Important changes affecting an existing subscription will be communicated as required by law and the rules shown at purchase.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.body: For questions about these terms, contact ReAvid Ltd at <link>{email}</link>.

metadata.title: Privacy policy | Bank Statement Converter
metadata.description: Learn how Bank Statement Converter handles bank statements, accounts, usage quotas, and billing information.

Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.intro: ReAvid Ltd operates <site>{domain}</site>. This policy explains how we handle information when you use the conversion and PayPal subscription services.
Privacy.availability: This policy applies to the currently available PDF to Excel conversion, account sign-in, and PayPal subscription features.

documents.title: Bank statements and conversion content
documents.body: Uploaded PDFs may contain names, account numbers, transaction dates, amounts, balances, and transaction descriptions. When conversion is available, we process the PDF, extracted transactions, and generated Excel file only to complete your requested conversion and download. We do not use this content for advertising or unrelated purposes.

accountData.title: Account, quota, and billing information
accountData.body: When you sign in with Google, Supabase stores the identity and account details needed to provide account services. After a subscription is activated, we store its status, plan, PayPal subscription identifier, billing period, payer email, and a snapshot of the website account email at purchase. PayPal handles payment information. These records do not contain PDF originals, extracted transactions, or Excel content.

technicalData.title: Necessary technical information
technicalData.body: To operate the website, maintain security, and investigate failures, we may process access time, IP address, browser or device information, and error records that do not contain statement content. To measure visits, Google Analytics and Pageview may receive access time, IP address, and browser or device information. We do not send bank statements, extracted transactions, or generated Excel content to these analytics services.

purposes.title: Processing purposes
purposes.body: Information is used only to complete conversions and downloads, measure and improve site visits, manage accounts and quotas, provide subscriptions and billing, respond to requests, maintain service security, and meet applicable legal obligations.

retention.title: Retention
retention.documents: PDFs, extracted transactions, and generated Excel files are used during the processing required for the current conversion and download only. They are not written to a persistent database, object storage, or file history, and are not kept for later download.
retention.metadata: Account, quota, and billing metadata is retained only as long as needed to provide the service or meet applicable legal obligations. It is deleted or anonymized when no longer needed according to the actual system and legal requirements. The account email stored at purchase is part of the subscription record.

providers.title: Providers and international processing
providers.body: Account sign-in uses Google and Supabase. Subscription payment and status synchronization use PayPal. Site visit measurement uses Google Analytics and Pageview, which may process technical visit information under their applicable terms and privacy policies. PayPal may process payment and account information under its applicable terms and privacy policy. If processing occurs across borders, we will apply the safeguards required by applicable law and describe the actual arrangement. We do not sell bank statements or transaction information.

storage.title: Browser storage
storage.body: The website uses browser local storage to remember appearance preferences and necessary session cookies to maintain sign-in. Analytics services may also use cookies or similar browser identifiers to measure visits. You can manage local storage and cookies through your browser settings.

security.title: Information security
security.body: We use reasonable measures appropriate to the sensitivity of the information being processed, but internet transmission and software systems cannot guarantee absolute security. Protect your original statements, downloaded Excel files, and account access details.

rights.title: Your privacy rights
rights.body: Depending on the laws that apply where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, or obtain a copy of personal information, or to object to or restrict certain processing. Contact us using the email below. Where applicable, you may also complain to a regulator. We will verify and handle requests under applicable law.

terms.title: Related terms
terms.body: Using the service also requires reading the <link>terms of service</link>.

changes.title: Policy updates
changes.body: We may update this policy when service features, processing methods, or legal requirements change and will show the update date on this page. We will notify users of material changes as required by applicable law.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.body: For questions about information processing or to exercise applicable privacy rights, contact ReAvid Ltd at <link>{email}</link>.
